description: Canonical single-call colour truth object. Returns everything known about a hex value: colour science (Lab, LCh, hue, chroma, depth, temperature, LRV), archive anchor with dE2000, claim_strength, do_not_say and evidence grade, hex provenance (status, confidence, spectrophotometric flag), physics (illuminant behaviour, gamut, print risk), and cultural reading (colour family, warnings, positives). Use this as the foundation call when you need the complete picture. Every other tool is built on this data. Replaces chaining colour_dna + archive_provenance + colour_cultural_risk + colour_metrics separately. Examples: '#31559B' (anchors to Henry VIII Manuscript Blue Initials), '#8B1A1A' (Penny Post Sealing Wax Dark Red), '#D4AF37' (Sutton Hoo Great Gold Buckle).

hexes.description: Multiple hex colours for batch lookup e.g. ['#31559B', '#8B1A1A']. Max 20.

include_cultural.description: Include cultural risk and associations (default true)

include_physics.description: Include illuminant behaviour and gamut data (default true)

n_archive.description: Number of archive matches to return (default 3)

name: colour_passport

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an ok boolean plus a result or results field with the tools data payload.

title: Colour Passport -- Complete Colour Truth Object
